panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores: physical CPU cores (placement VCPU / 2). vCPUs allocated: vCPUs of running instances. Frequency: current clock summed over all cores.

panels.title: RAM capacity (N-2)
panels.description: Host RAM Nova can use (placement total minus reserved per host), minus the two largest hosts in each region as failover headroom. Not multiplied by the allocation ratio.

panels.title: RAM: allocated / in guests / host used
panels.description: Allocated: flavor memory of the VMs. On host (QEMU): VM memory resident on the hypervisors. In guests: memory the guests use (maximum minus guest MemAvailable; page cache counts as free), for VMs that report guest memory stats (balloon driver). No guest stats: allocated memory of VMs that report none, not included in In guests. Host used: hypervisor MemTotal - MemAvailable. On host (QEMU RSS) and VMs without guest stats are in the Capacity trend graph.

panels.title: RX/TX Packets Per Sec on VMs
Other VM states
panels.description: Libvirt domain states, plus instances Nova has in ERROR (these often have no libvirt domain) or RESCUE (booted from a rescue image).

panels.title: Agents down or disabled
panels.description: Nova, Cinder and Neutron agents that are down, or administratively disabled (with the reason Nova or Cinder records).

panels.title: Instances in ERROR or a transitional state
panels.description: Nova instances that are not ACTIVE or SHUTOFF (ERROR, BUILD, REBOOT, RESCUE, MIGRATING, ...). Since: when the instance entered this state, from the last 30 days of metrics; the earliest date means it was already in this state when the data starts. ERROR instances often have no host.

targets.expr:
sort_desc(
  max_over_time((
  label_replace(purefa_volume_performance_throughput_iops{os_region=~"$cluster",dimension="writes_per_sec"}, "id", "$1", "name", "volume-(.*)-cinder")
  + on(id) group_left(volume_type, volume_name)
  (0 * max by (id, volume_type, volume_name) (label_replace(openstack_cinder_volume_gb{os_region=~"$cluster",volume_type=~".*-${iops_limit}$"}, "volume_name", "$1", "name", "(.*)")))
  )[$__range:1m]) / ${iops_limit} * 100 > 85
)

targets.expr:
label_replace(
  avg(purefa_volume_performance_throughput_iops{os_region=~"$cluster", dimension="writes_per_sec", name=~"volume-.*"}) by (instance,name),
  "id", "$1", "name", "volume-(.*)-cinder"
)
* on(id) group_left(volume_name, size, status, tenant_id, volume_type)
# Then, rename the name label to volume_name in the Cinder data
(label_replace(

    openstack_cinder_volume_gb{os_region=~"$cluster"},
    "volume_name", "$1", "name", "(.*)"

  "name", "volume-$1-cinder", "id", "(.*)"
) * 0 + 1)
and
topk($TopItems, 
  label_replace(
    avg(rate(purefa_volume_performance_throughput_iops{os_region=~"$cluster", dimension="writes_per_sec", name=~"volume-.*"}[$__range] @ end() )) by (instance,name),
    "id", "$1", "name", "volume-(.*)-cinder"
  )
  * on(id) group_left(volume_name, size, status, tenant_id, volume_type)
  (label_replace(

    "name", "volume-$1-cinder", "id", "(.*)"
  ) * 0 + 1)
)
